title: pkix-path-builder Error::NoValidPath wraps String
description:
In pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:198-203, Error::NoValidPath carries a last_error: String field. The rustdoc explains this is because pkix_path::Error does not implement Hash (which is needed for the derive on Error). But per the coding standards, error variants should carry structured fields, not String messages.

What goes wrong: Callers that need to programmatically distinguish 'last candidate failed with SignatureInvalid' from 'last candidate failed with ExpiredCert' cannot do so - they would have to parse the Display string, which is fragile.

Location: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:198-203

Recommendation: Either add Hash to pkix_path::Error (since it already has Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq), or carry the last pkix_path::Error directly and derive Hash manually on pkix_path_builder::Error, skipping the last_error field.
